distinguishing_features: In-line eddy current separation using high-frequency AC coil array in melt transfer section
Tuned to repel non-ferrous conductive contaminants while ferrous captured by preceding magnet
Non-contacting coil array embedded in melt hopper or transfer section
Decoupling ferrous and non-ferrous removal into two distinct physical stages
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to remove non-ferrous metal contaminants from recycled plastic melt without mechanical contact or screen clogging.
parsed.viable_reason: The eddy current repulsive force is insufficient to overcome the high viscous drag of the polymer melt, and the claimed transit time/flow velocity is unrealistic, making the mechanism physically implausible as written.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Since the mechanism is not viable, it cannot be a better invention; moreover, applying eddy current separation to a high-viscosity melt would be recognized as infeasible by a skilled engineer.
